statement: Every New Zealand company must have at least one director who lives in New Zealand, or who lives in Australia and is a current director of a company incorporated in Australia.
caveat: A director must also be a natural person 18 or over and not disqualified (undischarged bankrupts and persons prohibited under the Companies Act 1993 cannot act); the residency requirement sits in Companies Act 1993 s 10(d) with director qualifications in s 151 (legislation.govt.nz answers automated fetches with an AWS WAF challenge, recorded 2026-10-23). Check the live Companies Office guidance before appointing.
